name: Mimic

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.description: While in its true form, the mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the mimic is also Grappled by it (escape DC 13).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature Grappled by it.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the mimic is in its true form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the mimic. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

description: A mimic disguises itself as an inert object—most infamously a treasure chest—luring the greedy close enough to be swallowed by its adhesive, acidic bulk.
